Index: .opencode-web/response-comment-tracker.sh
===================================================================
--- .opencode-web/response-comment-tracker.sh	
+++ .opencode-web/response-comment-tracker.sh	
@@ -0,0 +1,185 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+started_at="$(date +%s)"
+
+format_elapsed() {
+  local elapsed_seconds="$1"
+  local elapsed_hours=$((elapsed_seconds / 3600))
+  local elapsed_minutes=$(((elapsed_seconds % 3600) / 60))
+
+  if (( elapsed_hours > 0 )); then
+    printf '%dh %02dm' "$elapsed_hours" "$elapsed_minutes"
+  else
+    printf '%dm' "$elapsed_minutes"
+  fi
+}
+
+if [[ "${1:-}" == "--format-elapsed" ]]; then
+  format_elapsed "${2:?elapsed seconds are required}"
+  printf '\n'
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+vision_calls() {
+  jq -r '
+    def has_image($message):
+      any((($message.parts // [])[]?);
+        (.type == "file" and ((.mime // .mediaType // "") | startswith("image/"))) or
+        (.type == "tool" and any(((.state.attachments // [])[]?.mime?); ((. // "") | startswith("image/"))))
+      );
+    reduce .[] as $message ({ seen: false, calls: 0 };
+      if $message.info.role == "assistant" then
+        .calls += (if .seen then 1 else 0 end)
+        | .seen = (.seen or has_image($message))
+      else
+        .seen = (.seen or has_image($message))
+      end
+    ) | .calls
+  '
+}
+
+while :; do
+  payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
+    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
+    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/$SESSION_ID/message" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+  sessions_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
+    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
+    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+  status_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
+    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
+    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/status" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+  if jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$payload" && \
+    jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$sessions_payload" && \
+    jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$status_payload"; then
+    stats="$(jq -r '
+      def parts: [.[].parts[]?];
+      def tools: [parts[] | select(.type == "tool")];
+      [
+        (tools | length),
+        ([tools[] | select(.state.status == "running" or .state.status == "pending")] | length)
+      ] | @tsv
+    ' <<<"$payload")"
+    IFS=$'\t' read -r tool_count active_count <<<"$stats"
+    subagent_stats="$(jq -nr \
+      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
+      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" \
+      --argjson statuses "$status_payload" '
+      def descendants($all; $parent):
+        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
+        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
+        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
+          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
+          end;
+      ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root)) as $subagents
+      | {
+          total: ($subagents | length),
+          failed: ([$statuses | to_entries[]
+            | select((.key as $id | ($subagents | index($id))) != null)
+            | select(.value.type == "error" or .value.type == "failed")
+          ] | length),
+          active: ([$statuses | to_entries[]
+            | select((.key as $id | ($subagents | index($id))) != null)
+            | select(.value.type != "idle" and .value.type != "error" and .value.type != "failed")
+          ] | length)
+        }
+      | [.active, .total, .failed] | @tsv
+    ')"
+    IFS=$'\t' read -r active_subagents total_subagents failed_subagents <<<"$subagent_stats"
+    token_count="$(jq -nr \
+      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
+      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" '
+      def descendants($all; $parent):
+        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
+        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
+        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
+          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
+          end;
+      ([$root] + ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root))) as $tracked
+      | reduce $sessions[] as $session (0;
+          if ($tracked | index($session.id)) == null then .
+          else .
+            + ($session.tokens.input // 0)
+            + ($session.tokens.output // 0)
+            + ($session.tokens.reasoning // 0)
+            + ($session.tokens.cache.read // 0)
+            + ($session.tokens.cache.write // 0)
+          end
+        )
+    ')"
+    subagent_ids="$(jq -nr \
+      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
+      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" '
+      def descendants($all; $parent):
+        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
+        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
+        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
+          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
+          end;
+      ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root))[]
+    ')"
+    vision_count="$(vision_calls <<<"$payload")"
+    while IFS= read -r subagent_id; do
+      [[ -n "$subagent_id" ]] || continue
+      subagent_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
+        -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
+        "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/$subagent_id/message" 2>/dev/null || true)"
+      if jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$subagent_payload"; then
+        subagent_vision_count="$(vision_calls <<<"$subagent_payload")"
+        vision_count=$((vision_count + subagent_vision_count))
+      fi
+    done <<<"$subagent_ids"
+    changed_count="$(git -C "$PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
+    elapsed_seconds="$(( $(date +%s) - started_at ))"
+    elapsed="$(format_elapsed "$elapsed_seconds")"
+    speed_score="$(awk -v tokens="$token_count" -v elapsed="$elapsed_seconds" \
+      'BEGIN { if (elapsed > 0) printf "%.1f", tokens / elapsed; else print "0.0" }')"
+    access_links="$(< "${PROGRESS_COMMENT_TEMPLATE:-$(dirname "$0")/opencode-progress-comment-template.md}")"
+    ssh_section=""
+    if [[ "${AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED:-false}" == "true" && "${AGENTSWEB_SSH_READY:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
+      ssh_section="🔐 **Temporary AgentsWeb SSH session is ready.**
+
+Run: ${RUN_URL}
+Host: ${SSH_HOST}:${SSH_PORT}
+
+Run this command while the job is active:
+
+Command:
+${SSH_COMMAND}
+"
+    fi
+    progress_stats="- Elapsed: ${elapsed}
+- Token count: ${token_count}
+- Speed score: ${speed_score} tokens/s
+- Tool calls: $tool_count
+- Active tool calls: $active_count
+- Active subagents: $active_subagents
+- Total subagents executed: $total_subagents
+- Total failed subagents: $failed_subagents
+- Image-context model calls: $vision_count
+- Changed workspace files: $changed_count"
+    validation_session_section=""
+    if [[ -s "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/validation-session-url" ]]; then
+      validation_session_section="🔎 **Validation OpenCode Web UI:** $(<"$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/validation-session-url")"
+    fi
+    access_note="This opens the currently running OpenCode session directly. Access remains available while OpenCode runs and for 5 hours afterwards."
+    access_links="${access_links//@SSH_SECTION@/$ssh_section}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@UPDATED@/$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@OPENCODE_WEB_URL@/$OPENCODE_WEB_URL}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@PROJECT_FILE_URL@/${PROJECT_FILE_URL:-unavailable}}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@VALIDATION_SESSION_SECTION@/$validation_session_section}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@PROGRESS_STATS@/$progress_stats}"
+    access_links="${access_links//@ACCESS_NOTE@/$access_note}"
+    body="${access_links}
+
+_Image-context model calls are inferred from image attachments in the session transcript. Message contents and tool details are hidden. Full logs are published in the completion release._"
+    if [[ "${PROGRESS_DRY_RUN:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
+      printf '%s\n' "$body" > "${PROGRESS_OUTPUT:?PROGRESS_OUTPUT is required in dry-run mode}"
+    else
+      gh api --method PATCH "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID" \
+        -f body="$body" >/dev/null || true
+    fi
+  fi
+  [[ -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/response-comment.done" ]] && break
+  sleep 10
+done

1: # OMG (Oh My GitHub) workflow
2: 
3: The canonical workflow is `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`.
4: The numbered build, verification, remediation, completion, and screenshot
5: prompt templates are stored as Markdown files in `.github/prompts/`.
6: 
7: ## Trigger
8: 
9: The `OpenCode` issue label is the execution marker consumed by the Oh My Github
10: App. The App dispatches `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`; the workflow itself
11: accepts only `workflow_dispatch` and does not subscribe directly to issue
12: events. The issue body, or title when the body is empty, supplies the request
13: text. Comments and edits never trigger execution. An issue with the `Goal` label
14: uses the installed `opencode-goal-plugin`, configures
15: `noInterruptOnUserMessage: true`, and starts the runner with `opencode run
16: --command goal`; an issue without `Goal` uses the standard `opencode run`
17: path. The `OpenCode` label asks the App to launch the workflow; add `Goal` to select
18: persistent goal mode. This keeps
19: one request event mapped to one OpenCode session.
20: 
21: An issue with the `ralph` label installs the standalone
22: [`opencode-ralph-loop`](https://github.com/charfeng1/opencode-ralph-loop) plugin
23: and starts `opencode run --command ralph-loop` in the same workflow session.
24: Ralph takes precedence when both `Goal` and `ralph` are present, which makes it
25: safe to add `ralph` to the usual Goal-labeled issue. The workflow requires
26: Ralph's `<promise>DONE</promise>` completion marker before validation and
27: completion reporting.
28: 
29: When a human opens an issue without `OpenCode`, the App posts a reminder to add
30: the label and stops; it does not dispatch a workflow. Adding `OpenCode` later
31: starts the normal App-dispatched flow.
32: 
33: The `test` label runs the full workflow with a mock OpenCode-generated project
34: and must be used alongside `OpenCode`. The App remains triggered only by the
35: exact `OpenCode` label. Test mode skips OpenCode generation, copies the fixture
36: from `.github/fixtures/test-project`, then runs local verification, pushes the
37: normal immutable branch, reports its OmGithub tree URL, and completes the issue.
38: It also emits the normal live-progress comment, final report, lifecycle labels,
39: and logs release from synthetic OpenCode session artifacts, so only the model
40: generation itself is replaced.
41: 
42: The workflow uses the `macos-latest` GitHub-hosted runner by default for the
43: entire OpenCode job. The `linux` label opts the run into `ubuntu-latest`.
44: 
45: An optional issue-title suffix in the exact form `branch: <existing-branch>`
46: selects the checkout. The App removes that suffix from the
47: OpenCode request and validates the branch before dispatching the thin workflow
48: wrapper.
49: Invalid or missing branches receive an issue comment and do not start the build.
50: Without the directive, the repository default branch is used.
51: 
52: See the dedicated [Oh My Github App documentation](oh-my-github-app.md) for
53: App ownership, installation scope, permissions, events, and webhook details.
54: 
55: An issue labeled `omo` additionally installs and configures the OpenCode Ultimate
56: edition of `oh-my-openagent` with Bun before the OpenCode server starts. The
57: installer runs non-interactively with provider authentication skipped; `/omo` is
58: not a command and does not trigger a run by itself. An `omo`-labeled OpenCode run
59: uses OMO's native `goal` command and prepends `ulw` to the objective. The Codex
60: Light `ulw-loop` component is not recreated or registered for OpenCode.
61: 
62: ## What the job does
63: 
64: 1. Checks out the repository with persisted `GITHUB_TOKEN` credentials.
65: 2. Copies `.github/templates/agents.template.md` to `$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md`,
66:    then appends every `.github/templates/*.md` file whose basename matches an
67:    issue label,
68:    excluding the base template itself. The worker therefore receives the
69:    shared issue-update, screenshot, and completion-report requirements plus all
70:    active label policies.
71: 3. Attempts to start an ephemeral AgentsWeb SSH tunnel. If setup fails, the
72:    workflow continues without SSH access and keeps the browser session path
73:    available.
74: 4. Starts the OpenCode web UI and a loopback Nginx file server rooted at the
75:    resolved project directory, then publishes each through its own temporary
76:    trycloudflare.com tunnel. The access comment contains both URLs, rendered
77:    from shared templates under `scripts/` for both its initial and
78:    live-progress forms. Final, smoke-test, blocked, failed, and SSH-closed
79:    comments use the same renderer and remain independently status-specific.
80: 5. Creates an `opencode/<run-id>` branch from the relevant base branch.
81: 6. Starts `opencode run --attach` against the same OpenCode installation and
82:    server-backed session store, then posts a direct URL to that live session.
83: 7. Verifies SSH connectivity when the optional tunnel was started successfully.
84: 8. Creates and refreshes one unified progress-comment template with aggregate
85:    OpenCode statistics about every 10 seconds while the run is active, keeping
86:    the launch access details intact. The report also
87:    counts active child sessions from `/session/status` and all descendant
88:    subagent sessions from their `parentID` lineage. It also reports inferred
89:    human-readable elapsed time, aggregate token count and tokens-per-second speed,
90:    plus inferred image-context model calls by following image MIME attachments
91:    through each session transcript.
92:    Message text, reasoning, prompts, and tool details are
93:    never rendered in the live comment; full logs are published only in the
94:    completion release.
95:    For Goal runs, the workflow inspects the finished session for an explicit
96:    `[goal:blocked]` result before validation. A blocked result is sent, with
97:    the original request and blocked evidence, to the OpenCode Zen Responses API
98:    using `.github/prompts/critique-blocked.md`; the generated continuation is
99:    forwarded to the same OpenCode session with `--session` and
100:    `--command goal`. This recovery is bounded to three attempts. If the same
101:    session remains blocked, the issue receives the `blocked` label and no
102:    completion report or `complete` label is published.
103: 9. Waits for the build session to finish, forks it into a separate verification
104:    session, runs the verification prompt there, starts the app, and exposes it through a
105:    separate temporary trycloudflare.com tunnel, and verifies the public URL.
106: 10. Verifies the app through the public tunnel. If verification fails, sends a
107:    remediation prompt to the forked verification session and retries up to three
108:    times. The completion report and screenshot evidence prompts also use that
109:    verification session. Detects both uncommitted generated files and commits already created
110:    by OpenCode, then pushes the immutable branch in YAML.
111: 11. Gives the verified public URL back to the worker, requests committed final
112:     browser screenshots, and appends immutable screenshot URLs with the game,
113:     commit, and Open Project links to the oldest triggering-issue comment containing the
114:     `🟡 **OpenCode progress (live)**` marker. If screenshots are missing, it
115:     sends up to two follow-up prompts to the same OpenCode session before
116:     continuing delivery with a warning.
117: 12. Creates a uniquely tagged GitHub release containing the final OpenCode
118:     response JSON and safe runner log files, then appends its link to that same
119:     live-progress comment.
120: 13. Keeps SSH, the OpenCode Web UI, and the app available for 5 hours after
121:    verification,
122:    then marks the comment closed and terminates both tunnels.
123: 
124: Validation is controlled by the repository variable `VALIDATION_ENABLED`. It
125: defaults to `true`. When set to `off` (or any value other than `true`), the
126: workflow stops after the initial OpenCode prompt and temporary OpenCode Web
127: trycloudflare exposure; app verification/remediation, completion and screenshot
128: prompts, Git delivery, immutable project publication, release/report generation, and the
129: complete label are skipped. The temporary access session still sleeps for five
130: hours before cleanup.
131: 
132: After the branch is pushed, the completion report links the full commit SHA to
133: OmGithub. Opening that URL anonymously downloads the public commit, discovers
134: root `index.html` or `dist/index.html` plus final screenshots, and creates the
135: store page and playable deployment. There is no separate publishing credential
136: or upload step.
137: See [OmGithub publishing](omgithub.md).
138: 
139: The OmGithub issue workspace polls issue comments every eight seconds. Its
140: header contains the four numbered workflow stages plus the currently executing
141: stage and description. On desktop it shows the live OpenCode session on the
142: left and the newest progress screenshot or playable preview on the right. At
143: the mobile breakpoint, Chat and Preview tabs keep only one iframe visible at a
144: time. Numbered preview controls retain access to every progress and final
145: screenshot found in issue comments.
146: 
147: The comment URL opens `/<encoded-worktree>/session/<session-id>` rather than
148: the web home page. This matters because the web home page stores its project
149: selection in the browser, while the runner's project exists only on the
150: temporary GitHub Actions filesystem.
151: 
152: ## Local tracker test
153: 
154: On macOS, run `./scripts/test-opencode-progress-tracker.sh`. It starts a local
155: mock OpenCode HTTP server with nested, active, and completed child sessions,
156: including user and tool image attachments, then asserts the three derived
157: progress counters.
158: 
159: The workflow uses the built-in OpenCode model path and does not require an
160: `OPENCODE_API_KEY` secret. To authenticate an ephemeral worker with the Mac's
161: OpenAI OAuth login, save the complete local OpenCode `auth.json` as the
162: `OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON` repository secret; the workflow passes it through
163: OpenCode's `OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT` environment variable. Branch creation and
164: pushing are deliberately handled by the workflow rather than by OpenCode's
165: GitHub integration.
166: 
167: ## Findings: tracking the GitHub run in Web UI
168: 
169: The previous GitHub integration installed the OpenCode CLI and ran:
170: 
171: ```sh
172: opencode github run
173: ```
174: 
175: The workflow now sends the comment text directly to `opencode run --attach --dir
176: <project-directory>`. The explicit directory is required when the CLI attaches
177: to a separately started OpenCode server; without it, the CLI can answer while
178: the resulting session is not visible in the intended Web UI workspace.
179: 
180: For the installed `opencode-goal-plugin`, invoke a goal from the non-interactive
181: CLI with `opencode run --command goal "<objective>"`; passing `/goal <objective>`
182: as the message sends literal text instead of invoking the custom command. To
183: send a follow-up to the same attached session, use `opencode run --attach
184: <server-url> --session <session-id> "<message>"`. In this workflow, the
185: issue text is passed directly as the objective before it is passed to the custom
186: command, and later human messages steer the running goal instead of
187: pausing it.
188: 
189: Before starting OpenCode, the workflow checks out `agents-dev/skills` into
190: `$PROJECT_DIR/.agents`. OpenCode discovers project skills from
191: `$PROJECT_DIR/.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md`.
192: The workflow excludes this nested skills checkout through `.git/info/exclude`
193: so it cannot be included in the generated app commit.
194: The workflow verifies the discovered skill list through OpenCode's `/skill`
195: endpoint and synchronizes `model/<provider>/<name>` and `skill/<name>` labels
196: in the repository.
197: This keeps the regular OpenCode session while making branch and immutable
198: commit behavior explicit and reviewable in YAML.
199: Model labels are refreshed from the live OpenCode catalog on each run and are
200: limited to models with zero input, output, and cache-read cost, plus the
201: explicitly allowed `opencode/gpt-5.6-luna` and `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` models.
202: Use `model/openai/gpt-5.6-luna` when the OpenAI provider is required. Default GitHub labels are removed, and
203: the triggering issue is marked `in progress`, `validating`, `complete`,
204: `blocked`, or `failed` as the job advances. `complete` means the Goal recovery
205: gate and validation pipeline passed; it is not a substitute for an explicit
206: blocked Goal result.
207: For difficult game requests, the `game-issue-e2e` skill selects the synchronized
208: `model/opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` label; if that label is
209: unavailable, the skill records that it used the workflow default instead.
210: 
211: The workflow reads the repository variable `PROJECT_DIR` as a repository-relative
212: project home. It defaults to `./`.
213: Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal are rejected. OpenCode Web and all
214: OpenCode runs use the resolved directory, and skill checkout, Git delivery,
215: and screenshot links use the same project home. OpenCode's server
216: also loads project instances per request using the `x-opencode-directory` header.
217: A tunneled browser request does not know the runner's `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, so
218: the UI can appear empty even while `opencode github run` is actively working.
219: 
220: The reliable architecture is:
221: 
222: ```text
223: opencode github run
224:         |
225:         v
226: shared OpenCode session/database
227:         ^
228:         | x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR
229:         |
230: trycloudflare tunnel -> workspace-scoped OpenCode Web UI
231: ```
232: 
233: The workflow starts OpenCode from `$PROJECT_DIR`, so its direct server is
234: already scoped to the checked-out worktree. API and session probes explicitly
235: send `x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR`, while Cloudflare tunnels directly
236: to that same loopback server. This avoids an extra reverse-proxy hop and keeps
237: WebSocket upgrades native. The access comment points to the encoded
238: canonical worktree/session route, so the browser opens the live run directly.
239: The resolver emits the repository root without a trailing `/.`; this keeps the
240: encoded browser route identical to OpenCode's canonical session directory. A loaded
241: Web UI or healthy tunnel alone does not prove session tracking; acceptance
242: requires a screenshot while the run is active.
243: 
244: ## Repository settings
245: 
246: - For runner-side SSH access and verification, configure the
247:   `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY` Actions secret with the public key matching the Mac
248:   private key described in [access.md](access.md). Without it, the workflow
249:   skips SSH setup and verification but still exposes the OpenCode Web session.

(End of file - total 249 lines)
</content>

   using `.github/prompts/critique-blocked.md`; the generated continuation is
   forwarded to the same OpenCode session with `--session` and
   `--command goal`. This recovery is bounded to three attempts. If the same
   session remains blocked, the issue receives the `blocked` label and no
   completion report or `complete` label is published.
9. Waits for the build session to finish, forks it into a separate verification
   session, runs the verification prompt there, starts the app, and exposes it through a
   separate temporary trycloudflare.com tunnel, and verifies the public URL.
10. Verifies the app through the public tunnel. If verification fails, sends a
   remediation prompt to the forked verification session and retries up to three
   times. The completion report and screenshot evidence prompts also use that
   verification session. Detects both uncommitted generated files and commits already created
   by OpenCode, then pushes the immutable branch in YAML.
11. Gives the verified public URL back to the worker, requests committed final
    browser screenshots, and appends immutable screenshot URLs with the game,
    commit, and Open Project links to the oldest triggering-issue comment containing the
    `🟡 **OpenCode progress (live)**` marker. If screenshots are missing, it
    sends up to two follow-up prompts to the same OpenCode session before
    continuing delivery with a warning.
12. Creates a uniquely tagged GitHub release containing the final OpenCode
    response JSON and safe runner log files, then appends its link to that same
    live-progress comment.
13. Keeps SSH, the OpenCode Web UI, and the app available for 5 hours after
   verification,
   then marks the comment closed and terminates both tunnels.

Validation is controlled by the repository variable `VALIDATION_ENABLED`. It
defaults to `true`. When set to `off` (or any value other than `true`), the
workflow stops after the initial OpenCode prompt and temporary OpenCode Web
trycloudflare exposure; app verification/remediation, completion and screenshot
prompts, Git delivery, immutable project publication, release/report generation, and the
complete label are skipped. The temporary access session still sleeps for five
hours before cleanup.

After the branch is pushed, the completion report links the full commit SHA to
OmGithub. Opening that URL anonymously downloads the public commit, discovers
root `index.html` or `dist/index.html` plus final screenshots, and creates the
store page and playable deployment. There is no separate publishing credential
or upload step.
See [OmGithub publishing](omgithub.md).

The OmGithub issue workspace polls issue comments every eight seconds. Its
header contains the four numbered workflow stages plus the currently executing
stage and description. On desktop it shows the live OpenCode session on the
left and the newest progress screenshot or playable preview on the right. At
the mobile breakpoint, Chat and Preview tabs keep only one iframe visible at a
time. Numbered preview controls retain access to every progress and final
screenshot found in issue comments.

The comment URL opens `/<encoded-worktree>/session/<session-id>` rather than
the web home page. This matters because the web home page stores its project
selection in the browser, while the runner's project exists only on the
temporary GitHub Actions filesystem.

## Local tracker test

On macOS, run `./scripts/test-opencode-progress-tracker.sh`. It starts a local
mock OpenCode HTTP server with nested, active, and completed child sessions,
including user and tool image attachments, then asserts the three derived
progress counters.

The workflow uses the built-in OpenCode model path and does not require an
`OPENCODE_API_KEY` secret. To authenticate an ephemeral worker with the Mac's
OpenAI OAuth login, save the complete local OpenCode `auth.json` as the
`OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON` repository secret; the workflow passes it through
OpenCode's `OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT` environment variable. Branch creation and
pushing are deliberately handled by the workflow rather than by OpenCode's
GitHub integration.

## Findings: tracking the GitHub run in Web UI

The previous GitHub integration installed the OpenCode CLI and ran:

```sh
opencode github run
```

The workflow now sends the comment text directly to `opencode run --attach --dir
<project-directory>`. The explicit directory is required when the CLI attaches
to a separately started OpenCode server; without it, the CLI can answer while
the resulting session is not visible in the intended Web UI workspace.

For the installed `opencode-goal-plugin`, invoke a goal from the non-interactive
CLI with `opencode run --command goal "<objective>"`; passing `/goal <objective>`
as the message sends literal text instead of invoking the custom command. To
send a follow-up to the same attached session, use `opencode run --attach
<server-url> --session <session-id> "<message>"`. In this workflow, the
issue text is passed directly as the objective before it is passed to the custom
command, and later human messages steer the running goal instead of
pausing it.

Before starting OpenCode, the workflow checks out `agents-dev/skills` into
`$PROJECT_DIR/.agents`. OpenCode discovers project skills from
`$PROJECT_DIR/.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md`.
The workflow excludes this nested skills checkout through `.git/info/exclude`
so it cannot be included in the generated app commit.
The workflow verifies the discovered skill list through OpenCode's `/skill`
endpoint and synchronizes `model/<provider>/<name>` and `skill/<name>` labels
in the repository.
This keeps the regular OpenCode session while making branch and immutable
commit behavior explicit and reviewable in YAML.
Model labels are refreshed from the live OpenCode catalog on each run and are
limited to models with zero input, output, and cache-read cost, plus the
explicitly allowed `opencode/gpt-5.6-luna` and `openai/gpt-5.6-luna` models.
Use `model/openai/gpt-5.6-luna` when the OpenAI provider is required. Default GitHub labels are removed, and
the triggering issue is marked `in progress`, `validating`, `complete`,
`blocked`, or `failed` as the job advances. `complete` means the Goal recovery
gate and validation pipeline passed; it is not a substitute for an explicit
blocked Goal result.
For difficult game requests, the `game-issue-e2e` skill selects the synchronized
`model/opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` label; if that label is
unavailable, the skill records that it used the workflow default instead.

The workflow reads the repository variable `PROJECT_DIR` as a repository-relative
project home. It defaults to `./`.
Absolute paths and parent-directory traversal are rejected. OpenCode Web and all
OpenCode runs use the resolved directory, and skill checkout, Git delivery,
and screenshot links use the same project home. OpenCode's server
also loads project instances per request using the `x-opencode-directory` header.
A tunneled browser request does not know the runner's `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, so
the UI can appear empty even while `opencode github run` is actively working.

The reliable architecture is:

```text
opencode github run
        |
        v
shared OpenCode session/database
        ^
        | x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR
        |
trycloudflare tunnel -> workspace-scoped OpenCode Web UI
```

The workflow starts OpenCode from `$PROJECT_DIR`, so its direct server is
already scoped to the checked-out worktree. API and session probes explicitly
send `x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR`, while Cloudflare tunnels directly
to that same loopback server. This avoids an extra reverse-proxy hop and keeps
WebSocket upgrades native. The access comment points to the encoded
canonical worktree/session route, so the browser opens the live run directly.
The resolver emits the repository root without a trailing `/.`; this keeps the
encoded browser route identical to OpenCode's canonical session directory. A loaded
Web UI or healthy tunnel alone does not prove session tracking; acceptance
requires a screenshot while the run is active.

name: OpenCode reusable pipeline

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Issue containing the OpenCode label
        required: true
        type: string
      request:
        description: Exact issue request text
        required: true
        type: string
      issue_title:
        description: Issue title for reporting
        required: true
        type: string
      labels_json:
        description: JSON array of issue label names
        required: false
        default: '[]'
        type: string
      sender:
        description: GitHub username that submitted the request
        required: true
        type: string
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY:
        required: false
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON:
        required: false
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY:
        required: false
jobs:
  opencode:
    # Ubuntu is the default; the mac label opts this run into macOS.
    runs-on: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"mac"') && 'macos-latest' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
    env:
      SSH_NAME: opencode-issue-${{ inputs.issue_number }}-${{ github.run_id }}-ssh
      SSH_KEY: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519
      SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519.pub
      SSH_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.opencode-ssh
      OPENCODE_WEB_PORT: 4096
      OPENCODE_WEB_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.opencode-web
      PROJECT_PATH: ${{ vars.PROJECT_DIR || './' }}
      PROJECT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ vars.PROJECT_DIR || './' }}
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WORKSPACES: "true"
      OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA: "true"
      OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS: "true"
      OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_WEBSOCKETS: "true"
      TARGET_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
      TARGET_REPO: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
      TARGET_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      TARGET_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      RUNTIME_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.omgithub-runtime
      APP_PORT: 3000
      BRANCH_NAME: opencode/${{ github.run_id }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY != '' }}
      TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
      COMMENT_BODY: ${{ inputs.request }}
      LABELS_JSON: ${{ inputs.labels_json }}
      TEST_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"test"') && contains(inputs.labels_json, '"OpenCode"') }}
      GOAL_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"Goal"') }}
      RALPH_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"ralph"') }}
      OMO_REQUEST: ${{ contains(inputs.labels_json, '"omo"') }}
      VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.VALIDATION_ENABLED || 'true' }}
    steps:
      - name: Publish task link
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          issue_url="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          {
            echo '## OpenCode task'
            echo
            echo "[Open triggering issue](${issue_url})"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Export target token
        shell: bash
        run: echo "GH_TOKEN=${{ github.token }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Checkout target repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          ref: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Checkout centralized OMG runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: AgentsLoop/OhMyGithub
          ref: main
          path: .omgithub-runtime
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout AgentsWeb tunnel client
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: agents-dev/agent-workspace
          path: .agentsweb
          sparse-checkout: |
            lolgames_tunnel
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Resolve project directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$TEST_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            PROJECT_PATH='workflow-test-project'
          fi
          if [[ "$PROJECT_PATH" = /* || "$PROJECT_PATH" =~ (^|/)\.\.(/|$) ]]; then
            echo "PROJECT_DIR must be a path inside the repository: $PROJECT_PATH" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          project_path="${PROJECT_PATH#./}"
          project_path="${project_path%/}"
          project_path="${project_path:-.}"
          if [[ "$project_path" == '.' ]]; then
            resolved_project_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          else
            resolved_project_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/$project_path"
          fi
          printf 'PROJECT_PATH=%s\n' "$project_path" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'PROJECT_DIR=%s\n' "$resolved_project_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Checkout shared OpenCode skills
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: agents-dev/skills
          path: ${{ vars.PROJECT_DIR || './' }}/.agents
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Exclude shared skills from generated changes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          project_path="${PROJECT_PATH#./}"
          project_path="${project_path%/}"
          skills_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/.agents/"
          ralph_state_path="${project_path:+/$project_path}/.opencode/ralph-loop.local.md"
          grep -qxF "$skills_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$skills_path" >> .git/info/exclude
          grep -qxF "$ralph_state_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$ralph_state_path" >> .git/info/exclude

          if [[ -z "$project_path" ]]; then
            for runtime_path in '/.agentsweb/' '/.omgithub-runtime/' '/.opencode-ssh/' '/.opencode-web/' \
              '/opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519' '/opencode-agentsweb-id_ed25519.pub'; do
              grep -qxF "$runtime_path" .git/info/exclude || echo "$runtime_path" >> .git/info/exclude
            done
          fi

      - name: Install worker instructions
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -d "$PROJECT_DIR"
          template_dir="$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/templates"
          base_template="$template_dir/agents.template.md"
          [[ -f "$base_template" ]] || { echo "Missing worker base template: $base_template" >&2; exit 1; }
          cp "$base_template" "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"

          append_template() {
            local template="$1"
            [[ -f "$template" ]] || { echo "Missing worker label template: $template" >&2; exit 1; }
            printf '\n' >> "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
            cat "$template" >> "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
          }

          # Append every label-matched template except the base template. This
          # keeps new templates convention-based: .github/templates/foo.md is selected
          # automatically by a foo issue label.
          while IFS= read -r template; do
            template_name="${template##*/}"
            template_stem="${template_name%.md}"
            if jq -e --arg name "$template_stem" \
              'any(.[]; (ascii_downcase == ($name | ascii_downcase)))' \
              <<< "$LABELS_JSON" >/dev/null; then
              append_template "$template"
            fi
          done < <(find "$template_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' ! -name 'agents.template.md' -print | sort)

          if [[ "$GOAL_REQUEST" == "true" && "$RALPH_REQUEST" != "true" ]]; then
            grep -qF 'When running in Goal mode' "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
          elif grep -qF 'When running in Goal mode' "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"; then
            echo 'Goal-mode instructions leaked into a non-Goal Agents.md.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$RALPH_REQUEST" == "true" ]]; then
            grep -qF 'When running in Ralph mode' "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"
          elif grep -qF 'When running in Ralph mode' "$PROJECT_DIR/Agents.md"; then
            echo 'Ralph-mode instructions leaked into a non-Ralph Agents.md.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Sync OpenCode labels
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          OPENCODE_MODEL: opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const path = require('node:path');

            const catalog = await fetch('https://models.opencode.ai/api.json').then(async (response) => {
              if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`OpenCode model catalog returned ${response.status}`);
              return response.json();
            });
            const models = Object.values(catalog.opencode?.models ?? {})
              .filter((model) =>
                (model.cost?.input === 0 && model.cost?.output === 0 && model.cost?.cache_read === 0) ||
                model.id === 'gpt-5.6-luna'
              )
              .map((model) => model.id)
              .filter(Boolean)
              .sort();
            if (!models.includes(process.env.OPENCODE_MODEL.slice('opencode/'.length))) {
              throw new Error(`Configured model is missing from the OpenCode catalog: ${process.env.OPENCODE_MODEL}`);
            }
            const openaiLuna = catalog.openai?.models?.['gpt-5.6-luna'];
            if (!openaiLuna) {
              throw new Error('OpenAI catalog is missing gpt-5.6-luna');
            }

            const skillsRoot = path.join(process.env.PROJECT_DIR, '.agents', 'skills');
            const skillNames = fs.existsSync(skillsRoot)
              ? fs.readdirSync(skillsRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
                  .filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory())
                  .filter((entry) => fs.existsSync(path.join(skillsRoot, entry.name, 'SKILL.md')))
                  .map((entry) => entry.name)
              : [];

            const labels = [
              { name: 'in progress', color: 'FBCA04', description: 'OpenCode workflow is running' },
              { name: 'validating', color: '1D76DB', description: 'OpenCode workflow is validating the result' },
              { name: 'complete', color: '0E8A16', description: 'OpenCode workflow completed successfully' },
              { name: 'blocked', color: 'D93F0B', description: 'OpenCode Goal needs user input or bounded recovery was exhausted' },
              { name: 'failed', color: 'B60205', description: 'OpenCode workflow failed' },
              { name: 'Goal', color: '8A2BE2', description: 'Run OMG with the persistent Goal command' },
              { name: 'ralph', color: '5319E7', description: 'Run OpenCode with the Ralph auto-continuation loop' },
              { name: 'omo', color: '5319E7', description: 'Preinstall oh-my-openagent for this OpenCode run' },
              { name: 'test', color: '1D76DB', description: 'Run the full workflow with a mock OpenCode-generated project' },
              { name: 'mac', color: 'B60205', description: 'Run OpenCode on the macos-latest GitHub-hosted runner' },
              { name: 'linux', color: '1D76DB', description: 'Run OpenCode on the ubuntu-latest GitHub-hosted runner' },
              ...models.map((model) => ({
                name: `model/opencode/${model}`,
                color: '5319E7',
                description: `OpenCode model: opencode/${model}`
              })),
              {
                name: 'model/openai/gpt-5.6-luna',
                color: '5319E7',
                description: 'OpenAI model: openai/gpt-5.6-luna'
              },
              ...skillNames.map((name) => ({
                name: `skill/${name}`,
                color: '1D76DB',
                description: `OpenCode skill: ${name}`
              }))
            ];

            for (const label of labels) {
              try {
                await github.rest.issues.createLabel({
                  owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
                  repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                  ...label
                });
              } catch (error) {
                if (error.status !== 422) throw error;
                await github.rest.issues.updateLabel({
                  owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
                  repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                  name: label.name,
                  color: label.color,
                  description: label.description
                });
              }
            }

            const managedPrefixes = ['model/', 'skill/'];
            const defaultLabels = new Set([
              'bug', 'documentation', 'duplicate', 'enhancement', 'good first issue',
              'help wanted', 'invalid', 'question', 'wontfix'
            ]);
            const existing = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listLabelsForRepo, {
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              per_page: 100
            });
            const desired = new Set(labels.map(({ name }) => name));
            for (const label of existing) {
              if (defaultLabels.has(label.name) ||
                  (managedPrefixes.some((prefix) => label.name.startsWith(prefix)) && !desired.has(label.name))) {
                await github.rest.issues.deleteLabel({
                  owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
                  repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                  name: label.name
                });
              }
            }

            core.info(`Synchronized ${labels.length} labels from the live OpenCode catalog and shared skills`);

      - name: Mark issue in progress
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          GOAL_REQUEST: ${{ env.GOAL_REQUEST }}
          RALPH_REQUEST: ${{ env.RALPH_REQUEST }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('node:fs');
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const statuses = ['in progress', 'validating', 'complete', 'blocked', 'failed'];
            for (const status of statuses) {
              try {
                await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
                  owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                  issue_number: number, name: status
                });
              } catch (error) {
                if (error.status !== 404) throw error;
              }
            }
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              labels: [
                'in progress',
                ...(process.env.GOAL_REQUEST === 'true' ? ['Goal'] : []),
                ...(process.env.RALPH_REQUEST === 'true' ? ['ralph'] : [])
              ]
            });

      - name: Start AgentsWeb SSH session
        id: agentsweb
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED == 'true'
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER starts at 1 in every repository, so using it here
          # makes every new repository's first OMG run contend for port 32001.
          # GITHUB_RUN_ID is globally unique and distributes runs across the
          # broker's 32000-32999 public-port range.
          SSH_PORT=$((32000 + GITHUB_RUN_ID % 1000))
          echo "SSH_PORT=$SSH_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == 'Linux' ]]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y openssh-server tmux
          else
            command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install tmux
          fi
          install -d -m 700 "$SSH_DIR"
          ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f "$SSH_KEY" -N '' -q
          chmod 600 "$SSH_KEY"
          install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.ssh"
          {
            cat "$SSH_PUBLIC_KEY"
            printf '%s\n' '${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}'
          } > "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
          chmod 600 "$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys"
          [[ "$RUNNER_OS" != 'Linux' ]] || sudo mkdir -p /run/sshd
          sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -p 2222 -o PasswordAuthentication=no \
            -o PermitRootLogin=no -o PubkeyAuthentication=yes
          is_listening() {
            if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              ss -ltn | grep -q ':2222 '
            else
              lsof -nP -iTCP:2222 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1
            fi
          }
          for _ in {1..20}; do
            is_listening && break
            sleep 1
          done
          is_listening
          nohup env PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.agentsweb" \
            python3 -m lolgames_tunnel client 127.0.0.1:2222 \
            --server agentsweb.space --name "$SSH_NAME" --public-port "$SSH_PORT" \
            > "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.pid"
          for _ in {1..45}; do
            grep -q 'agentsweb.space' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log" && break
            sleep 1
          done
          grep -q 'agentsweb.space' "$SSH_DIR/tunnel.log"
          SSH_HOST="${SSH_NAME}.agentsweb.space"
          SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p ${SSH_PORT} runner@${SSH_HOST}"
          printf 'host=%s\nport=%s\ncommand=%s\n' "$SSH_HOST" "$SSH_PORT" "$SSH_COMMAND" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Start OpenCode web UI and Cloudflare tunnel
        id: opencode_web
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -d -m 700 "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
          OPENCODE_VERSION="$(
            curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
              https://api.github.com/repos/anomalyco/opencode/releases/latest \
              | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"v\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'
          )"
          [[ "$OPENCODE_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://opencode.ai/install \
            | bash -s -- --version "$OPENCODE_VERSION"
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          [[ -x "$OPENCODE_BIN" ]]
          install -d -m 700 "$HOME/.config/opencode"
          cat > "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" <<'EOF'
          {
            "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
            "plugin": [],
            "permission": {
              "*": "allow",
              "task": "allow"
            }
          }
          EOF
          if [[ "$OMO_REQUEST" == 'true' && "$RALPH_REQUEST" != 'true' ]]; then
            echo 'Installing oh-my-openagent for the omo-labeled request'
            if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://bun.sh/install | bash
            fi
            export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
            export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
            command -v bun
            bunx oh-my-openagent install \
              --no-tui \
              --platform=opencode \
              --claude=no \
              --openai=no \
              --gemini=no \
              --copilot=no \
              --opencode-zen=no \
              --zai-coding-plan=no \
              --opencode-go=no \
              --kimi-for-coding=no \
              --bailian-coding-plan=no \
              --minimax-cn-coding-plan=no \
              --minimax-coding-plan=no \
              --vercel-ai-gateway=no \
              --skip-auth
          fi
          config_tmp="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode.json"
          if [[ "$RALPH_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            npm install --prefix "$HOME/.config/opencode" --no-save --no-package-lock \
              --ignore-scripts opencode-ralph-loop@1.0.10
            jq '
              .plugin = ((.plugin // []) + ["opencode-ralph-loop"]) |
              .permission = ((.permission // {}) + {"*": "allow", "task": "allow"})
            ' "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
          elif [[ "$OMO_REQUEST" != 'true' ]]; then
            npm install --prefix "$HOME/.config/opencode" --no-save --no-package-lock \
              --ignore-scripts opencode-goal-plugin@0.8.2
            jq '
              .plugin = ((.plugin // []) + [["opencode-goal-plugin", {"noInterruptOnUserMessage": true}]]) |
              .command.goal = {
                "description": "Set a session-scoped goal and auto-continue until complete.",
                "template": "$ARGUMENTS",
                "agent": "build"
              } |
              .permission = ((.permission // {}) + {"*": "allow", "task": "allow"})
            ' "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
          else
            jq '.permission = ((.permission // {}) + {"*": "allow", "task": "allow"})' \
              "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json" > "$config_tmp"
          fi
          mv "$config_tmp" "$HOME/.config/opencode/opencode.json"
          PORTS="$(node --input-type=module -e '
            import net from "node:net";
            const ports = [];
            for (let index = 0; index < 2; index += 1) {
              const server = net.createServer();
              await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                server.once("error", reject);
                server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", resolve);
              });
              ports.push(server.address().port);
              server.close();
            }
            console.log(ports.join(" "));
          ')"
          read -r OPENCODE_WEB_PORT PROJECT_FILE_PORT <<< "$PORTS"
          [[ "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$PROJECT_FILE_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          {
            printf 'OPENCODE_WEB_PORT=%s\n' "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT"
            printf 'PROJECT_FILE_PORT=%s\n' "$PROJECT_FILE_PORT"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "Allocated OpenCode port: $OPENCODE_WEB_PORT"
          echo "Allocated project file server port: $PROJECT_FILE_PORT"
          nohup "$OPENCODE_BIN" serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port "$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode.pid"
          wait_for_http() {
            local url="$1"
            local attempts="$2"
            local response_code
            for _ in $(seq 1 "$attempts"); do
              response_code="$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 \
                --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true)"
              if [[ "$response_code" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
                return 0
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
            return 1
          }
          wait_for_http_response() {
            local url="$1"
            local attempts="$2"
            local response_code
            for _ in $(seq 1 "$attempts"); do
              response_code="$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 3 \
                --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' "$url" || true)"
              if [[ "$response_code" =~ ^[1-5][0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
                return 0
              fi
              sleep 1
            done
            return 1
          }
          if ! wait_for_http "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/global/health" 45; then
            echo 'OpenCode server did not become healthy; server log follows:' >&2
            curl --silent --show-error --max-time 10 \
              -i "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/global/health" >&2 || true
            sed -n '1,160p' "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode.log" >&2 || true
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            case "$RUNNER_OS" in
              Linux)
                sudo apt-get update
                sudo apt-get install -y nginx
                ;;
              macOS)
                brew install nginx
                ;;
              *)
                echo "Nginx is not installed and cannot be provisioned on $RUNNER_OS" >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          fi
          NGINX_BIN="$(command -v nginx)"
          NGINX_PREFIX="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/nginx"
          install -d -m 700 "$NGINX_PREFIX" "$NGINX_PREFIX/client_body_temp" \
            "$NGINX_PREFIX/proxy_temp" "$NGINX_PREFIX/fastcgi_temp" \
            "$NGINX_PREFIX/uwsgi_temp" "$NGINX_PREFIX/scgi_temp"
          cat > "$NGINX_PREFIX/nginx.conf" <<EOF
          worker_processes 1;
          pid $NGINX_PREFIX/nginx.pid;
          error_log $NGINX_PREFIX/error.log;
          events { worker_connections 128; }
          http {
            access_log $NGINX_PREFIX/access.log;
            client_body_temp_path $NGINX_PREFIX/client_body_temp;
            proxy_temp_path $NGINX_PREFIX/proxy_temp;
            fastcgi_temp_path $NGINX_PREFIX/fastcgi_temp;
            uwsgi_temp_path $NGINX_PREFIX/uwsgi_temp;
            scgi_temp_path $NGINX_PREFIX/scgi_temp;
            server {
              listen 127.0.0.1:$PROJECT_FILE_PORT;
              root $PROJECT_DIR;
              index __codex_no_automatic_index_file__;
              autoindex on;
            }
          }
          EOF
          "$NGINX_BIN" -t -c "$NGINX_PREFIX/nginx.conf" -p "$NGINX_PREFIX"
          "$NGINX_BIN" -c "$NGINX_PREFIX/nginx.conf" -p "$NGINX_PREFIX"
          if ! wait_for_http "http://127.0.0.1:$PROJECT_FILE_PORT/" 15; then
            echo 'Nginx project file server did not become healthy; server log follows:' >&2
            sed -n '1,160p' "$NGINX_PREFIX/error.log" >&2 || true
            exit 1
          fi
          echo 'Cloudflare will tunnel directly to the workspace-scoped OpenCode server and project file server'
          case "$RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" in
            Linux/X64) CLOUDFLARED_ASSET='cloudflared-linux-amd64' ;;
            Linux/ARM64) CLOUDFLARED_ASSET='cloudflared-linux-arm64' ;;
            macOS/X64) CLOUDFLARED_ASSET='cloudflared-darwin-amd64.tgz' ;;
            macOS/ARM64) CLOUDFLARED_ASSET='cloudflared-darwin-arm64.tgz' ;;
            *) echo "Unsupported runner platform: $RUNNER_OS/$RUNNER_ARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if [[ "$CLOUDFLARED_ASSET" == *.tgz ]]; then
            curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --output "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared.tgz" \
              "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/$CLOUDFLARED_ASSET"
            tar -xzf "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared.tgz" -C "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" cloudflared
          else
            curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --output "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared" \
              "https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/$CLOUDFLARED_ASSET"
          fi
          chmod 755 "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared"
          nohup "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared" tunnel --no-autoupdate --url "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared.pid"
          nohup "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared" tunnel --no-autoupdate --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PROJECT_FILE_PORT" \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/project-cloudflared.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/project-cloudflared.pid"
          for _ in {1..60}; do
            WEB_URL="$(sed -nE 's#.*(https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com).*#\1#p' "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared.log" | head -n 1)"
            PROJECT_URL="$(sed -nE 's#.*(https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com).*#\1#p' "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/project-cloudflared.log" | head -n 1)"
            [[ -n "$WEB_URL" && -n "$PROJECT_URL" ]] && break
            sleep 1
          done
          [[ -n "${WEB_URL:-}" && -n "${PROJECT_URL:-}" ]]
          printf 'url=%s\nproject_url=%s\n' "$WEB_URL" "$PROJECT_URL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Configure Git identity
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name 'opencode[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'

      - name: Create OpenCode branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_BRANCH="$TARGET_REF"
          git fetch origin "$BASE_BRANCH"
          git checkout -B "$BRANCH_NAME" "origin/$BASE_BRANCH"

      - name: Generate mock OpenCode project
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p install -d "$PROJECT_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p cp -R "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/fixtures/test-project/." "$PROJECT_DIR/"
          /usr/bin/time -p node "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/write-build-metadata.mjs" \
            "$PROJECT_DIR/build.json" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER" "$TARGET_REPOSITORY"
          /usr/bin/time -p test -f "$PROJECT_DIR/index.html"
          /usr/bin/time -p test -f "$PROJECT_DIR/package.json"
          /usr/bin/time -p install -d "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
          /usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s\n' \
            'Mock OpenCode generation started.' \
            "Copied the committed fixture into $PROJECT_DIR." \
            'Mock OpenCode generation completed successfully.' \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-run.log"
          /usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s\n' \
            'Mock verification session completed successfully.' \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/verification.log"
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          /usr/bin/time -p jq -n \
            --arg id "ses_mock_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --arg request "$COMMENT_BODY" \
            '[
              {info:{role:"user"},parts:[{type:"text",text:$request}]},
              {info:{role:"assistant"},parts:[{type:"text",text:"Mock OpenCode copied the fixture project and completed generation."}]}
            ]' > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-response.json"
          printf 'MOCK_SESSION_ID=ses_mock_%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Verify mock OpenCode project locally
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true'
        id: mock_project
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          /usr/bin/time -p npm run start -- --port "$APP_PORT" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/mock-project.log" 2>&1 &
          server_pid=$!
          trap 'kill "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          for _ in {1..30}; do
            if page="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT")"; then
              grep -q 'mock-opencode-project' <<< "$page"
              /usr/bin/time -p mkdir -p screenshots
              /usr/bin/time -p npx --yes playwright@latest install chromium
              /usr/bin/time -p npx --yes playwright@latest screenshot \
                --browser chromium \
                --wait-for-selector='[data-testid="mock-opencode-project"]' \
                --wait-for-timeout=500 \
                "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT" \
                screenshots/final-mock-opencode.png
              /usr/bin/time -p test -s screenshots/final-mock-opencode.png
              printf 'screenshots_json=["final-mock-opencode.png"]\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/mock-project.log" >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Resolve OpenCode model and skill labels
        id: opencode_labels
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const response = await github.rest.issues.listLabelsOnIssue({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              sort: 'created',
              direction: 'asc',
              per_page: 100
            });
            const names = response.data.map(({ name }) => name);
            const modelLabels = names.filter((name) => name.startsWith('model/'));
            if (modelLabels.length > 1) {
              core.setFailed(`Expected at most one model/* label, found: ${modelLabels.join(', ')}`);
              return;
            }
            const model = modelLabels[0]?.slice('model/'.length) || 'opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free';
            const skills = names.filter((name) => name.startsWith('skill/'))
              .map((name) => name.slice('skill/'.length)).sort();
            core.setOutput('model', model);
            core.setOutput('skills_json', JSON.stringify(skills));
            core.info(`Resolved model=${model}; skills=${skills.join(', ') || '(none)'}`);

      - name: Run OpenCode and locate its web session
        id: opencode_run
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          OPENCODE_WEB_URL: ${{ steps.opencode_web.outputs.url }}
          OPENCODE_MODEL: ${{ steps.opencode_labels.outputs.model }}
          OPENCODE_SKILLS: ${{ steps.opencode_labels.outputs.skills_json }}
          GOAL_REQUEST: ${{ env.GOAL_REQUEST }}
          RALPH_REQUEST: ${{ env.RALPH_REQUEST }}
          OMO_REQUEST: ${{ env.OMO_REQUEST }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          PROMPT_FILE="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/prompt.txt"
          RUN_LOG="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-run.log"
          RUN_EXIT="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-run.exit"
          skill_text="$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "(none)" else join(", ") end' <<<"$OPENCODE_SKILLS")"
          prompt_template="$(< "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/prompts/01-build.md")"
          request_text="$COMMENT_BODY"
          prompt="${prompt_template//@COMMENT_BODY@/$request_text}"
          prompt="${prompt//@OPENCODE_MODEL@/$OPENCODE_MODEL}"
          prompt="${prompt//@SKILL_TEXT@/$skill_text}"
          if [[ "$OMO_REQUEST" == 'true' && "$RALPH_REQUEST" != 'true' ]]; then
            prompt=$'ulw\n\n'"$prompt"
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "$prompt" > "$PROMPT_FILE"
          if [[ "$OMO_REQUEST" == 'true' && "$RALPH_REQUEST" != 'true' ]]; then

1169:           pin_tunnel_dns() {
1170:             local url="$1"
1171:             local host
1172:             local ips
1173:             host="${url#https://}"
1174:             host="${host%%/*}"
1175:             ips="$(dig @1.1.1.1 +short A "$host" | awk '/^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){3}$/ { print }')"
1176:             if [[ -z "$ips" ]]; then
1177:               echo "Authoritative DNS lookup failed for $host."
1178:               return 1
1179:             fi
1180:             while IFS= read -r ip; do
1181:               [[ -z "$ip" ]] && continue
1182:               if ! grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*${ip}[[:space:]]+${host}[[:space:]]*$" /etc/hosts; then
1183:                 echo "$ip $host" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
1184:               fi
1185:             done <<< "$ips"
1186:           }
1187: 
1188:           for attempt in 1 2 3; do
1189:             echo "Starting public app verification attempt $attempt/3."
1190:             [[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid" ]] || kill "$(cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
1191:             [[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid" ]] || kill "$(cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
1192:             : > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log"
1193:             : > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log"
1194: 
1195:             PORT="$APP_PORT" npm run start -- --port "$APP_PORT" >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log" 2>&1 &
1196:             echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid"
1197:             local_ok=''
1198:             for _ in {1..30}; do
1199:               if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT" >/dev/null; then
1200:                 local_ok='yes'
1201:                 break
1202:               fi
1203:               sleep 1
1204:             done
1205: 
1206:             if [[ "$local_ok" != 'yes' ]]; then
1207:               echo "Local app health check failed on attempt $attempt."
1208:             else
1209:               "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared" tunnel --no-autoupdate \
1210:                 --url "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT" \
1211:                 > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log" 2>&1 &
1212:               echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid"
1213:               APP_URL=''
1214:               for _ in {1..60}; do
1215:                 APP_URL="$(sed -nE 's#.*(https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com).*#\1#p' \
1216:                   "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log" | head -n 1)"
1217:                 [[ -n "$APP_URL" ]] && break
1218:                 sleep 1
1219:               done
1220:               public_app_ok=''
1221:               if [[ -n "$APP_URL" ]]; then
1222:                 dns_ok=''
1223:                 for _ in {1..90}; do
1224:                   if pin_tunnel_dns "$APP_URL"; then
1225:                     dns_ok='yes'
1226:                     break
1227:                   fi
1228:                   sleep 2
1229:                 done
1230:                 if [[ "$dns_ok" != 'yes' ]]; then
1231:                   echo "Public app DNS did not propagate for $APP_URL."
1232:                   continue
1233:                 fi
1234:                 for _ in {1..60}; do
1235:                   if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 10 "$APP_URL" >/dev/null; then
1236:                     public_app_ok='yes'
1237:                     break
1238:                   fi
1239:                   sleep 2
1240:                 done
1241:               fi
1242:               if [[ "$public_app_ok" == 'yes' ]]; then
1243:                 echo "APP_URL=$APP_URL" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
1244:                 echo "Public app verified at $APP_URL."
1245:                 exit 0
1246:               fi
1247:               echo "Public app health check failed on attempt $attempt ($APP_URL)."
1248:             fi
1249: 
1250:             if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
1251:               echo "Sending OpenCode remediation prompt before retry $((attempt + 1))/3."
1252:               "$OPENCODE_BIN" run --auto --dangerously-skip-permissions \
1253:                 --attach "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
1254:                 --dir "$PROJECT_DIR" \
1255:                 --session "$SESSION_ID" \
1256:                 --model "$OPENCODE_MODEL" \
1257:                 "$FIX_PROMPT" \
1258:                 >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/verification-fix-$attempt.log" 2>&1
1259:             fi
1260:           done
1261: 
1262:           echo 'Public app verification failed after 3 attempts.'
1263:           exit 1

      - name: Fork OpenCode session for verification
        id: verification_fork

        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |

          [[ "$code" == 0 ]]

          BUILD_SESSION_ID='${{ steps.opencode_run.outputs.session_id }}'
          VERIFICATION_SESSION_ID="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
            -X POST \
            -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
            "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/$BUILD_SESSION_ID/fork" \
            | jq -r '.id // empty')"
          [[ "$VERIFICATION_SESSION_ID" == ses_* ]]
          DIRECTORY_B64="$(printf '%s' "$PROJECT_DIR" | base64 | tr -d '\n' | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=')"
          printf 'session_id=%s\nsession_url=%s\n' "$VERIFICATION_SESSION_ID" \
            "${{ steps.opencode_web.outputs.url }}/${DIRECTORY_B64}/session/${VERIFICATION_SESSION_ID}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf '%s\n' "${{ steps.opencode_web.outputs.url }}/${DIRECTORY_B64}/session/${VERIFICATION_SESSION_ID}" \

        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
