      - name: Verify browser entrypoint exists
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          SESSION_ID='${{ steps.verification_fork.outputs.session_id }}'
          ENTRYPOINT_PROMPT='The browser verifier cannot find a playable HTML entrypoint. Ensure the requested app has a working index.html at the project root or dist/index.html, make the app server serve that entrypoint on port 3000, and verify it in the browser before replying.'

          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if [[ -f "$PROJECT_DIR/index.html" || -f "$PROJECT_DIR/dist/index.html" ]]; then
              if [[ -f "$PROJECT_DIR/index.html" ]]; then
                echo "Browser entrypoint found at $PROJECT_PATH/index.html."
              else
                echo "Browser entrypoint found at $PROJECT_PATH/dist/index.html."
              fi
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "No browser entrypoint found under $PROJECT_PATH (attempt $attempt/3)."
            if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
              "$OPENCODE_BIN" run --auto --dangerously-skip-permissions \
                --attach "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
                --dir "$PROJECT_DIR" \
                --session "$SESSION_ID" \
                --model "$OPENCODE_MODEL" \
                "$ENTRYPOINT_PROMPT" \
                >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/entrypoint-fix-$attempt.log" 2>&1
            fi
          done

          echo "Browser verification cannot continue without index.html or dist/index.html." >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Expose verified app
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
        id: app_tunnel
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          SESSION_ID='${{ steps.verification_fork.outputs.session_id }}'
          FIX_PROMPT="$(< "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/prompts/03-public-app-fix.md")"

          pin_tunnel_dns() {
            local url="$1"
            local host
            local ips
            host="${url#https://}"
            host="${host%%/*}"
            ips="$(dig @1.1.1.1 +short A "$host" | awk '/^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){3}$/ { print }')"
            if [[ -z "$ips" ]]; then
              echo "Authoritative DNS lookup failed for $host."
              return 1
            fi
            while IFS= read -r ip; do
              [[ -z "$ip" ]] && continue
              if ! grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*${ip}[[:space:]]+${host}[[:space:]]*$" /etc/hosts; then
                echo "$ip $host" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts >/dev/null
              fi
            done <<< "$ips"
          }

          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo "Starting public app verification attempt $attempt/3."
            [[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid" ]] || kill "$(cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
            [[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid" ]] || kill "$(cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
            : > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log"
            : > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log"

            PORT="$APP_PORT" npm run start -- --port "$APP_PORT" >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log" 2>&1 &
            echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.pid"
            local_ok=''
            for _ in {1..30}; do
              if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT" >/dev/null; then
                local_ok='yes'
                break
              fi
              sleep 1
            done

            if [[ "$local_ok" != 'yes' ]]; then
              echo "Local app health check failed on attempt $attempt."
            else
              "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/cloudflared" tunnel --no-autoupdate \
                --url "http://127.0.0.1:$APP_PORT" \
                > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log" 2>&1 &
              echo $! > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.pid"
              APP_URL=''
              for _ in {1..60}; do
                APP_URL="$(sed -nE 's#.*(https://[a-z0-9-]+\.trycloudflare\.com).*#\1#p' \
                  "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app-cloudflared.log" | head -n 1)"
                [[ -n "$APP_URL" ]] && break
                sleep 1
              done
              public_app_ok=''
              if [[ -n "$APP_URL" ]]; then
                dns_ok=''
                for _ in {1..90}; do
                  if pin_tunnel_dns "$APP_URL"; then
                    dns_ok='yes'
                    break
                  fi
                  sleep 2
                done
                if [[ "$dns_ok" != 'yes' ]]; then
                  echo "Public app DNS did not propagate for $APP_URL."
                  continue
                fi
                for _ in {1..60}; do
                  if curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 10 "$APP_URL" >/dev/null; then
                    public_app_ok='yes'
                    break
                  fi
                  sleep 2
                done
              fi
              if [[ "$public_app_ok" == 'yes' ]]; then
                echo "APP_URL=$APP_URL" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
                echo "Public app verified at $APP_URL."
                exit 0
              fi
              echo "Public app health check failed on attempt $attempt ($APP_URL)."
            fi

            if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
              echo "Sending OpenCode remediation prompt before retry $((attempt + 1))/3."
              "$OPENCODE_BIN" run --auto --dangerously-skip-permissions \
                --attach "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
                --dir "$PROJECT_DIR" \
                --session "$SESSION_ID" \
                --model "$OPENCODE_MODEL" \
                "$FIX_PROMPT" \
                >> "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/verification-fix-$attempt.log" 2>&1
            fi
          done

          echo 'Public app verification failed after 3 attempts.'
          exit 1
        env:
          OPENCODE_MODEL: ${{ steps.opencode_labels.outputs.model }}

      - name: Publish worker completion report
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
        shell: bash
        working-directory: ${{ env.PROJECT_DIR }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          completion_prompt="$(< "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/prompts/04-completion-report.md")"
          completion_prompt="${completion_prompt//@APP_URL@/$APP_URL}"
          completion_prompt="${completion_prompt//@TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER@/$TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          "$OPENCODE_BIN" run --auto --dangerously-skip-permissions \
            --attach "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
            --dir "$PROJECT_DIR" \
            --session "${{ steps.verification_fork.outputs.session_id }}" \
            --model "${{ steps.opencode_labels.outputs.model }}" \
            "$completion_prompt" \
            > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/completion-report.log" 2>&1
          touch "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/response-comment.done"

      - name: Request and verify final screenshots
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true' && env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
        id: final_evidence
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OPENCODE_BIN="$HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode"
          SESSION_ID='${{ steps.verification_fork.outputs.session_id }}'
          SCREENSHOT_PROMPT="$(< "$RUNTIME_DIR/.github/prompts/05-screenshot-evidence.md")"

          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            screenshots=()
            while IFS= read -r screenshot; do
              screenshots+=("$screenshot")
            done < <(find "$PROJECT_DIR/screenshots" -type f \
              \( -iname 'final-*.png' -o -iname 'final-*.jpg' -o -iname 'final-*.jpeg' -o -iname 'final-*.webp' \) \
              -exec basename {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort)
            if [[ "${#screenshots[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "${screenshots[@]}"
              printf 'screenshots_json=%s\n' "$(printf '%s\n' "${screenshots[@]}" | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              printf 'screenshots_status=present\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "No final screenshots found under $PROJECT_PATH/screenshots/ (attempt $attempt/3)."
            if [[ "$attempt" -lt 3 ]]; then
              echo "Sending OpenCode screenshot remediation prompt before retry $((attempt + 1))/3."
              if ! "$OPENCODE_BIN" run --auto --dangerously-skip-permissions \
                --attach "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT" \
                --dir "$PROJECT_DIR" \
                --session "$SESSION_ID" \
                --model '${{ steps.opencode_labels.outputs.model }}' \
                "$SCREENSHOT_PROMPT" \
                > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/screenshot-fix-$attempt.log" 2>&1; then
                echo "OpenCode screenshot remediation failed on attempt $attempt; continuing to the next evidence check."
              fi
            fi
          done

          echo 'Final screenshots are still missing after three remediation attempts; continuing with delivery.'
          printf 'screenshots_json=[]\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'screenshots_status=missing\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Push project branch
        if: env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true' || env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true'
        id: delivery
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_BRANCH="$TARGET_REF"
          # Dependencies are runtime-only and must never be included in the generated commit.
          /usr/bin/time -p touch "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore"
          grep -qxF 'node_modules/' "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore" || \
            printf '\nnode_modules/\n' >> "$PROJECT_DIR/.gitignore"
          /usr/bin/time -p git add -A -- "$PROJECT_PATH"
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            /usr/bin/time -p git commit -m "OpenCode: ${COMMENT_BODY%%$'\n'*}"
          fi
          if git diff --quiet "origin/$BASE_BRANCH..HEAD" -- "$PROJECT_PATH"; then
            echo 'OpenCode made no changes; no project branch will be published.'
            exit 0
          fi
          /usr/bin/time -p git push --set-upstream origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
          FINAL_COMMIT="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          printf 'commit=%s\n' "$FINAL_COMMIT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Create OpenCode logs release
        if: success() && (env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true' || env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true')
        id: opencode_release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-release"
          mkdir -p "$release_dir"

          # Preserve machine-readable responses and execution logs without
          # publishing OpenCode configuration, credentials, or SSH material.
          if [[ "$TEST_REQUEST" == 'true' ]]; then
            cp "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/opencode-response.json" "$release_dir/opencode-response.json"
            printf '%s\n' 'Synthetic OpenCode session used the committed fixture; downstream workflow steps are real.' \
              > "$release_dir/mock-session.txt"
          else
            curl --fail --silent --show-error \
              -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
              "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/${{ steps.opencode_run.outputs.session_id }}/message" \
              > "$release_dir/opencode-response.json"
          fi
          if [[ ! -s "$release_dir/opencode-response.json" ]]; then
            echo 'OpenCode response artifact is empty; refusing to create an incomplete release.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          for artifact in "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"/*.log "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$artifact" && -s "$artifact" ]] || continue
            [[ "$(basename "$artifact")" == 'opencode.json' ]] && continue
            cp -f "$artifact" "$release_dir/"
          done

          release_assets=()
          for asset in "$release_dir"/*; do
            [[ -f "$asset" && -s "$asset" ]] || continue
            release_assets+=("$asset")
          done
          ((${#release_assets[@]} > 0))

          tag="opencode-logs-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          gh release create "$tag" "${release_assets[@]}" \
            --target "${{ steps.delivery.outputs.commit || github.sha }}" \
            --title "OpenCode logs for run #${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}" \
            --notes "Generated OpenCode response and execution logs for workflow run [#${GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER}](https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID})." \
            --latest=false

          release_json="$(gh release view "$tag" --json url,assets)"
          printf 'url=%s\n' "$(jq -r '.url' <<<"$release_json")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          printf 'assets_json=%s\n' "$(jq -c '[.assets[] | {name, url: .browserDownloadUrl}]' <<<"$release_json")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

      - name: Post final game report
        if: success() && (env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true' || env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true')
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          FINAL_COMMIT: ${{ steps.delivery.outputs.commit }}
          SCREENSHOTS_JSON: ${{ steps.final_evidence.outputs.screenshots_json || steps.mock_project.outputs.screenshots_json }}
          PROJECT_PATH: ${{ env.PROJECT_PATH }}
          OPENCODE_RELEASE_URL: ${{ steps.opencode_release.outputs.url }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const commitUrl = `https://github.com/${process.env.TARGET_REPOSITORY}/commit/${process.env.FINAL_COMMIT}`;
            const projectUrl = `https://omgithub.com/${process.env.TARGET_REPOSITORY}/tree/${process.env.FINAL_COMMIT}`;
            const screenshots = JSON.parse(process.env.SCREENSHOTS_JSON || '[]');
            const { renderTemplate } = require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/opencode-comment-templates.cjs`);
            const projectPath = process.env.PROJECT_PATH.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
            const images = screenshots.map((name) => {
              const path = [projectPath, 'screenshots', name].filter(Boolean).join('/').split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
              const url = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${process.env.TARGET_REPOSITORY}/${process.env.FINAL_COMMIT}/${path}`;
              return `![Final game screenshot: ${name}](${url})`;
            });
            const body = renderTemplate('opencode-final-report.md', {
              PROJECT_URL: projectUrl,
              FINAL_COMMIT: process.env.FINAL_COMMIT,
              COMMIT_URL: commitUrl,
              RELEASE_URL: process.env.OPENCODE_RELEASE_URL,
              IMAGES: images.join('\n')
            });
            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments, {
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              per_page: 100
            });
            const liveComment = comments.find((comment) =>
              typeof comment.body === 'string' &&
              comment.body.includes('🟡 **OpenCode progress (live)**')
            );
            if (!liveComment) {
              throw new Error('Could not find the first OpenCode live-progress comment to update.');
            }
            await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              comment_id: liveComment.id,
              body: `${liveComment.body.trim()}\n\n${body}`
            });

      - name: Mark issue complete
        if: success() && env.GOAL_BLOCKED != 'true' && (env.TEST_REQUEST == 'true' || env.VALIDATION_ENABLED == 'true')
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, name: 'in progress'
            }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, name: 'validating'
            }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, name: 'blocked'
            }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, labels: ['complete']
            });

      - name: Mark issue blocked
        if: failure() && env.GOAL_BLOCKED == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const runUrl = `https://github.com/${process.env.TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const { renderTemplate } = require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/opencode-comment-templates.cjs`);
            for (const name of ['in progress', 'validating', 'complete', 'failed']) {
              await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
                owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
                issue_number: number, name
              }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            }
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, labels: ['blocked']
            });
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              body: renderTemplate('opencode-blocked-comment.md', { RUN_URL: runUrl })
            });

      - name: Mark issue failed
        if: failure() && env.GOAL_BLOCKED != 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          script: |
            const number = Number(process.env.TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER);
            const runUrl = `https://github.com/${process.env.TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${context.runId}`;
            const { renderTemplate } = require(`${process.env.RUNTIME_DIR}/.github/scripts/opencode-comment-templates.cjs`);
            const jobs = await github.paginate(github.rest.actions.listJobsForWorkflowRun, {
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              run_id: context.runId,
              per_page: 100
            });
            const failedSteps = jobs
              .flatMap((job) => (job.steps || [])
                .filter((step) => step.conclusion === 'failure')
                .map((step) => `${job.name}: ${step.name}`));
            const details = failedSteps.length
              ? failedSteps.map((step) => `- \`${step}\``).join('\n')
              : '- See the workflow logs for the failing step.';
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER,
              repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number,
              body: renderTemplate('opencode-failed-comment.md', { RUN_URL: runUrl, FAILED_STEPS: details })
            });
            await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, name: 'in progress'
            }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            await github.rest.issues.removeLabel({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, name: 'validating'
            }).catch((error) => { if (error.status !== 404) throw error; });
            await github.rest.issues.addLabels({
              owner: process.env.TARGET_OWNER, repo: process.env.TARGET_REPO,
              issue_number: number, labels: ['failed']
            });

      - name: Keep temporary access available for 5 hours
        if: success() && env.TEST_REQUEST != 'true'
        shell: bash

      - name: Append SSH session closed

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

started_at="$(date +%s)"

format_elapsed() {
  local elapsed_seconds="$1"
  local elapsed_hours=$((elapsed_seconds / 3600))
  local elapsed_minutes=$(((elapsed_seconds % 3600) / 60))

  if (( elapsed_hours > 0 )); then
    printf '%dh %02dm' "$elapsed_hours" "$elapsed_minutes"
  else
    printf '%dm' "$elapsed_minutes"
  fi
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--format-elapsed" ]]; then
  format_elapsed "${2:?elapsed seconds are required}"
  printf '\n'
  exit 0
fi

vision_calls() {
  jq -r '
    def has_image($message):
      any((($message.parts // [])[]?);
        (.type == "file" and ((.mime // .mediaType // "") | startswith("image/"))) or
        (.type == "tool" and any(((.state.attachments // [])[]?.mime?); ((. // "") | startswith("image/"))))
      );
    reduce .[] as $message ({ seen: false, calls: 0 };
      if $message.info.role == "assistant" then
        .calls += (if .seen then 1 else 0 end)
        | .seen = (.seen or has_image($message))
      else
        .seen = (.seen or has_image($message))
      end
    ) | .calls
  '
}

while :; do
  payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/$SESSION_ID/message" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  sessions_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  status_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
    -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/status" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$payload" && \
    jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$sessions_payload" && \
    jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$status_payload"; then
    stats="$(jq -r '
      def parts: [.[].parts[]?];
      def tools: [parts[] | select(.type == "tool")];
      [
        (tools | length),
        ([tools[] | select(.state.status == "running" or .state.status == "pending")] | length)
      ] | @tsv
    ' <<<"$payload")"
    IFS=$'\t' read -r tool_count active_count <<<"$stats"
    subagent_stats="$(jq -nr \
      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" \
      --argjson statuses "$status_payload" '
      def descendants($all; $parent):
        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
          end;
      ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root)) as $subagents
      | {
          total: ($subagents | length),
          failed: ([$statuses | to_entries[]
            | select((.key as $id | ($subagents | index($id))) != null)
            | select(.value.type == "error" or .value.type == "failed")
          ] | length),
          active: ([$statuses | to_entries[]
            | select((.key as $id | ($subagents | index($id))) != null)
            | select(.value.type != "idle" and .value.type != "error" and .value.type != "failed")
          ] | length)
        }
      | [.active, .total, .failed] | @tsv
    ')"
    IFS=$'\t' read -r active_subagents total_subagents failed_subagents <<<"$subagent_stats"
    token_count="$(jq -nr \
      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" '
      def descendants($all; $parent):
        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
          end;
      ([$root] + ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root))) as $tracked
      | reduce $sessions[] as $session (0;
          if ($tracked | index($session.id)) == null then .
          else .
            + ($session.tokens.input // 0)
            + ($session.tokens.output // 0)
            + ($session.tokens.reasoning // 0)
            + ($session.tokens.cache.read // 0)
            + ($session.tokens.cache.write // 0)
          end
        )
    ')"
    subagent_ids="$(jq -nr \
      --arg root "$SESSION_ID" \
      --argjson sessions "$sessions_payload" '
      def descendants($all; $parent):
        [$all[] | select(.parentID == $parent)] as $children
        | ($children | map(.id)) as $ids
        | if ($ids | length) == 0 then $ids
          else $ids + ([$ids[] | descendants($all; .)] | add)
          end;
      ($sessions | descendants($sessions; $root))[]
    ')"
    vision_count="$(vision_calls <<<"$payload")"
    while IFS= read -r subagent_id; do
      [[ -n "$subagent_id" ]] || continue
      subagent_payload="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
        -H "x-opencode-directory: $PROJECT_DIR" \
        "http://127.0.0.1:$OPENCODE_WEB_PORT/session/$subagent_id/message" 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$subagent_payload"; then
        subagent_vision_count="$(vision_calls <<<"$subagent_payload")"
        vision_count=$((vision_count + subagent_vision_count))
      fi
    done <<<"$subagent_ids"
    changed_count="$(git -C "$PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
    elapsed_seconds="$(( $(date +%s) - started_at ))"
    elapsed="$(format_elapsed "$elapsed_seconds")"
    speed_score="$(awk -v tokens="$token_count" -v elapsed="$elapsed_seconds" \
      'BEGIN { if (elapsed > 0) printf "%.1f", tokens / elapsed; else print "0.0" }')"
    access_links="$(< "${PROGRESS_COMMENT_TEMPLATE:-$(dirname "$0")/opencode-progress-comment-template.md}")"
    ssh_section=""
    if [[ "${AGENTSWEB_SSH_ENABLED:-false}" == "true" && "${AGENTSWEB_SSH_READY:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
      ssh_section="🔐 **Temporary AgentsWeb SSH session is ready.**

Run: ${RUN_URL}
Host: ${SSH_HOST}:${SSH_PORT}

Run this command while the job is active:

Command:
${SSH_COMMAND}
"
    fi
    progress_stats="- Elapsed: ${elapsed}
- Token count: ${token_count}
- Speed score: ${speed_score} tokens/s
- Tool calls: $tool_count
- Active tool calls: $active_count
- Active subagents: $active_subagents
- Total subagents executed: $total_subagents
- Total failed subagents: $failed_subagents
- Image-context model calls: $vision_count
- Changed workspace files: $changed_count"
    validation_session_section=""
    if [[ -s "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/validation-session-url" ]]; then
      validation_session_section="🔎 **Validation OpenCode Web UI:** $(<"$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/validation-session-url")"
    fi
    access_note="This opens the currently running OpenCode session directly. Access remains available while OpenCode runs and for 5 hours afterwards."
    access_links="${access_links//@SSH_SECTION@/$ssh_section}"
    access_links="${access_links//@UPDATED@/$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')}"
    access_links="${access_links//@OPENCODE_WEB_URL@/$OPENCODE_WEB_URL}"
    access_links="${access_links//@PROJECT_FILE_URL@/${PROJECT_FILE_URL:-unavailable}}"
    access_links="${access_links//@VALIDATION_SESSION_SECTION@/$validation_session_section}"
    access_links="${access_links//@PROGRESS_STATS@/$progress_stats}"
    access_links="${access_links//@ACCESS_NOTE@/$access_note}"
    body="${access_links}

_Image-context model calls are inferred from image attachments in the session transcript. Message contents and tool details are hidden. Full logs are published in the completion release._"
    if [[ "${PROGRESS_DRY_RUN:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$body" > "${PROGRESS_OUTPUT:?PROGRESS_OUTPUT is required in dry-run mode}"
    else
      gh api --method PATCH "repos/$REPOSITORY/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID" \
        -f body="$body" >/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  [[ -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/response-comment.done" ]] && break
  sleep 10
done

I want you to build a first-person shooter at the level of the most recent Call of Duty games. It should be utterly perfect, visually beautiful, with every single thing done at AAA quality—from textures to physics to anything you could think of.

Fan out sub-agents and have sub-agents tackle each one individually so that the game is utterly perfect. Have a separate sub-agent check each item visually to ensure it looks triple A. Do this in ThreeJS. Continue iterating until it's utterly perfect. Fan out sub-agents and ultracode.

I want you to build a first-person shooter at the level of the most recent Call of Duty games. It should be utterly perfect, visually beautiful, with every single thing done at AAA quality—from textures to physics to anything you could think of.

Fan out sub-agents and have sub-agents tackle each one individually so that the game is utterly perfect. Have a separate sub-agent check each item visually to ensure it looks triple A. Don't stop until each sub-agent is utterly wowed with the quality when compared with the actual Call of Duty game. It should literally compare them side by side blind and say which one looks better. # Worker instructions You are building the app or game requested in the triggering GitHub issue. Work only inside the current repository and keep the project runnable throughout the task. ## GitHub progress updates Use `gh issue comment "$TRIGGER_ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"` to publish useful progress updates to the triggering issue. Post an update after each meaningful playable or visible milestone, and whenever work becomes blocked. Each update must include: - a short summary of completed work; - the current status and known blockers (write `None` when there are none); - links to relevant pushed commits and any available public preview; - one screenshot showing the latest newly completed UI or gameplay milestone. Save milestone screenshots under `screenshots/`. Before embedding one in an issue comment, commit it, push the current branch, and use an immutable URL in this form: ```text https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY//screenshots/ ``` Embed the screenshot in an expandable block in the same progress comment: ```html
Screenshot
``` Use only one screenshot per progress comment. Never claim a UI or gameplay milestone is complete without opening the running game and capturing visible evidence. ## Completion requirements Before declaring the game complete: 1. Run the relevant tests and verify the playable game in a real browser. 2. Capture final screenshots of the playable game and save them under `screenshots/` using names beginning with `final-`. 3. Commit and push all final code and screenshots. 4. Post a final issue comment containing: - a concise summary of the completed game; - the public game link; - the final commit link; - deployment and test status; - known limitations (write `None` when there are none); - final screenshots embedded in expandable blocks in the comment. The workflow may also publish a completion comment from the committed evidence. The workflow owns the final immutable branch commit and project link.
